name: copilot-agent-mesh
description: Preview agent mesh with Worker hosting on Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS arm64.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Copilot Agent Mesh can delegate coding tasks. Worker execution requires a trusted local workspace on Windows x64/ARM64 or macOS arm64.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Remote task execution requires local filesystem-backed workspaces.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_list_workers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find authorized Device -> Window -> Workspace targets for delegation. Use scope=local for same-device work without remote requests, remote for paired devices, or all (default). Prefer the returned targetHandle with mesh_delegate_task; legacy exact IDs remain supported. Handles are temporary, window-scoped selection references, not execution grants; re-list stale targets instead of matching names. Results contain safe metadata, not paths or secrets. status=partial and issues explicitly identify a failed scope while preserving available targets. A listed or allowed target is not proof that its Agent runtime is available.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find authorized windows and Workspaces on this device or paired devices.

scope.description: Choose the discovery scope. local never requests remote directories.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_delegate_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delegate one task to targetHandle from mesh_list_workers, or the legacy explicit target IDs, never both. Omit continueFromTaskId for a new session; set it to an owned completed task on the same exact target to start a NEW task/turn in its retained session with conversation history. Unavailable or busy sessions fail explicitly, never fall back to a new session. mode=wait (default) waits for completion, input, failure or cancellation. mode=submit returns after durable acceptance so other targets can be scheduled; accepted is NOT completed. Use mesh_get_task with waitFor=outcome to resume waiting. After submit returns, stopping Chat does not cancel the task: use mesh_cancel_task. Omit delegationRequestId for fresh work, including a continuation; reuse it only for identical target/continueFromTaskId/title/prompt/criteria/execution-timeout semantics. mode does not change execution identity. Readable results include outcome, taskId, delegationRequestId, taskState and nextAction. outcome describes this call; taskState describes proven task state, or unknown. Budget fallback uses s=0 completed, 1 needsInput, 2 failed call, 3 cancelled call, 4 accepted, with t/d IDs and optional taskState. Preserve IDs for recovery; do not infer task completion from acceptance or cancellation intent. Execution timeout defaults to and is capped at 60 minutes. Sensitive operations still require parent input. Do not use this tool for Git, branch, worktree, commit, push or pull request management.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delegate to a target Workspace; wait for the result or submit and continue coordinating.

targetHandle.description: Preferred temporary selection reference from mesh_list_workers. Do not combine it with explicit target IDs.

mode.description: wait preserves completion-wait behavior. submit returns after durable acceptance; use get/wait or explicit cancel afterward.

delegationRequestId.description: Optional invocation identity. Omit for fresh work; reuse only for an exact execution retry. Changed semantics return IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

continueFromTaskId.description: Optional owned completed task whose retained session to reuse on this exact target. Creates a new task and turn, not a retry. Omit for a new session. No new-session fallback.

deviceId.description: Explicit opaque target device ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

nodeId.description: Explicit opaque target node ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

nodeInstanceId.description: Explicit target node instance ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

workspaceId.description: Opaque workspace ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

peerId.description: Optional internal routing metadata for a remote device; it does not replace explicit target IDs.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Optional acceptance criteria; each item is limited to 4 KiB UTF-8.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_get_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a bounded owned-task snapshot, or reattach after submission, an answer or interrupted delegation. waitFor=snapshot (default) reads once; change waits for an update; outcome waits for needsInput or terminal state. Event-driven waits avoid polling. waitSeconds defaults to 60 and is capped at 3600; initial/final reads also have bounded request deadlines. Cancelling or timing out this read-only wait never cancels the task. waitOutcome and snapshotIsLastRead explicitly distinguish a finished wait from an older snapshot; inspect snapshot.status, not the success of this query, for task state. Event gaps/truncation are explicit. Use mesh_cancel_task for cancellation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect a task or wait for its next input or result without restarting it.

waitSeconds.description: Event-wait budget, default 60 seconds for change/outcome only. Expiry stops waiting, not task execution.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_cancel_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explicitly request cancellation of a task owned by this window. A receipt may still say cancelling: it is not proof of cancelled state; use mesh_get_task to observe the authoritative result. Delegate wait-mode token cancellation and execution-budget expiry also request task cancellation. Stopping a read-only get/wait, or stopping Chat after submit returned, does not.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Request cancellation of a delegated task.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_answer_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Answer the exact pending question or approval request of an owned task, using taskId and inputId from the latest result (compact fallback t/i), plus a stable caller-generated answerId for exact retries. The native confirmation shows the current question and a safe answer preview. An answer receipt is not task completion: continue with mesh_get_task(waitFor=outcome) using the same taskId. Do not invent an input ID or approve future requests.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send an answer to a delegated task that is waiting for input.

taskId.description: Owned task ID waiting for input.

inputId.description: Exact pending input ID returned by delegate or get/wait.

answerId.description: Stable answer ID used for idempotent retries.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_list_tasks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recover task IDs owned by this current authenticated window, including several submitted tasks. Reads the local task index/cache only; no remote refresh, authentication or execution. It never lists tasks merely sharing a repo, incoming peer-owned tasks or another window owner. lastKnownState may be stale or ambiguous: use mesh_get_task for authoritative state. Defaults to active tasks, limit=20; includeTerminal adds history, and nextBeforeTaskId pages older owned entries. Reopening a repo under a new window identity does not transfer task ownership.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find this window’s delegated tasks and recover their IDs.

beforeTaskId.description: Pagination cursor returned as nextBeforeTaskId by a previous list.

copilotAgentMesh.deviceName.markdownDescription: The name used to identify this device to trusted peers.

copilotAgentMesh.codePath.markdownDescription: Optional VS Code CLI path for the Worker Agent Host runtime. Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS arm64 are supported; the current installation is discovered automatically.

copilotAgentMesh.experimental.peerDelega.markdownDescription: Enable same-device peer window discovery, policy configuration, and task tools. Enabled by default; disable to opt out. Incoming task reception and directional Workspace authorization remain default-deny.

copilotAgentMesh.agentHost.userDataDir.markdownDescription: Override the current VS Code instance user-data directory for editor Agent Host discovery. Leave empty for automatic platform/product derivation.

copilotAgentMesh.experimental.authentica.markdownDescription: Maps an AHP protected-resource or authorization-server URL to a VS Code authentication provider ID and exact scopes. No provider or scope is inferred.

copilotAgentMesh.workspace.capabilityTag.markdownDescription: Capability tags published for newly registered workspaces. Paths and credentials must not be used as tags.

scripts.precompile-tests: npm run ahp:build && npm run windows:build
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.bundle: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.package:vsix: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --pre-release --no-dependencies --out artifacts/copilot-agent-mesh-0.5.0-preview.vsix && npm run verify:vsix
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && node --test out/src/unitTest/*.test.js out/src/test/unit/*.test.js scripts/go-license.test.mjs
scripts.test:two-instance-real: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node scripts/e2e/two-instance/run.mjs
scripts.test:multi-window-real: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node scripts/e2e/multi-window/run.mjs
scripts.test:extension: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:component && npm run test:extension
scripts.verify: npm run test:unit && npm run test:component && npm run test:extension && npm run package:vsix
scripts.test:agent-host-auth-e2e: npm run compile-tests && node out/src/e2e/agentHost.e2e.js auth-boundary
scripts.test:agent-host-success-e2e: npm run compile-tests && node out/src/e2e/agentHost.e2e.js success-turn
